qp1.prompt: Welcome to 8.04, Quantum Physics I, with Professor Allan Adams, Barton Zwiebach and Matt Evans. In 8.04 we study superposition, the wavefunction, electron spin, hardness and color boxes, Planck's constant.

alg1.prompt: Welcome to 6.006, Introduction to Algorithms, with Jason Ku, Erik Demaine and Justin Solomon. In 6.006 we cover algorithms, data structures, asymptotic analysis, big O, the word-RAM model, induction, correctness and efficiency.

la1.prompt: This is 18.06, Linear Algebra, with Professor Gilbert Strang. In 18.06 we study linear equations, the row picture, the column picture, matrix A times vector x, linear combinations, elimination and singular matrices.
